name: Input
description: Mortar foundation input, using central semantic tokens. Supports text prefix/suffix add-ons, decorative leading/trailing icons and an attached action button.

props.label: string
props.prefix: string (static text before the value, e.g. https://)
props.suffix: string (static text after the value, e.g. % or .com)
props.leadingIcon: ReactNode (decorative icon inside the text box, before the value)
props.trailingIcon: ReactNode (decorative icon inside the text box, after the value)
props.action: ReactNode (an attached action control at the end of the field, e.g. a Button or menu; not static text or units)
props.required: boolean (native; adds a decorative marker to the label)

contract.usage: Import { Input } from @tonycodes-ui/mortar. Use prefix/suffix for static text adornments, leadingIcon/trailingIcon for decorative icons inside the text box, and action for an attached control such as Sort or Copy. When migrating an unlabeled native input, move absolute icons and end labels onto these props instead of wrapping the labeled Input.
contract.avoid: Do not put static text in action (use suffix/prefix). Do not absolutely position decorative siblings next to Input (they centre against the label as well as the text box; use leadingIcon/trailingIcon). Do not copy implementations, override central colours or grant component approval.
contract.accessibility: Verify accessible names, keyboard interaction, visible focus, responsive layout and supported states.
